# Isaac Lins

> A blog about tech, programming, and whatever interests me. Deep dives into software, tools, and the digital world.

## Blog posts

- [Claude was not the bottleneck. Claude Code was.](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/claude-code-was-the-bottleneck/index.md): Claude is still insanely good. I left Claude Code because the harness around it became the bottleneck, then built a setup I can actually change.
- [How to tokenmaxx in Claude](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/how-to-tokenmaxx-in-claude/index.md): Online, tokenmaxxing means burning more tokens to look productive. Real tokenmaxxing is the opposite: more thinking per token. With a prompt you can paste.
- [Git wasn't built for agents](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/git-wasnt-built-for-agents/index.md): Git was built for humans typing code. Now AI writes a lot of it. Zed's DeltaDB and Cursor's Origin want to save the whole conversation with the AI, not just the final code.
- [Why SpaceX paid $60 billion for a VSCode fork](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/why-spacex-paid-60-billion-for-a-vscode-fork/index.md): SpaceX bought Cursor for $60 billion in shares, not cash. They didn't really want the code editor. They wanted the millions of people coding inside it, and the data they create.
- [The US government just pulled Fable 5 offline](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/fable-5-mythos-5-suspended/index.md): The US government ordered Anthropic to suspend Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for foreign nationals. Anthropic shut them off for everyone. Here's what happened.
- [Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5: what Anthropic actually shipped](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/claude-fable-5-mythos-5/index.md): Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 explained: Anthropic's new Mythos class models, what they can do, the safeguards behind them, and what they cost.
- [Spotify macOS native: I got tired of the stock app and built my own](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/spotiglass/index.md): Spotify macOS native client Spotiglass: SwiftUI, not their Chromium shell. Why the official desktop app still loses, and what I actually shipped.
- [Building a Codex-Style Coding App](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/building-a-codex-style-coding-app/index.md): Build a Codex-style AI coding app with tool calling, file edits, and an agent loop in about 200 lines.
- [Notepad Can Run Code Now. No, Not Like That.](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/notepad-markdown-rce/index.md): Microsoft added Markdown to Notepad and accidentally shipped an 8.8 CVSS remote code execution vulnerability. Here's how CVE-2026-20841 works.
- [Notepad++ Got Hijacked by State Hackers. Your Text Editor.](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/notepad-plus-plus-hijack/index.md): State-sponsored hackers compromised Notepad++ updates for 6 months. Here's exactly how they did it and what you need to do.
- [Cloudflare Took a Sick Day](https://isaaclins.com/pr-preview/pr-65/blog/cloudflare-nov-18-2025-outage/index.md): Cloudflare's Nov 18 outage knocked dashboards, WARP, and Access offline worldwide—here's what broke and how to harden your own stack.
